units: <cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 9:31">Targ. Ex. IX, 31</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 10:2:17">Y. Snh. X, 29ᵃ</cite> bot. (in Hebr. dict.) <he>זרעו חטים וכ׳</he> sow wheat and flax.
Yoma 71ᵇ מאי … כ׳ הוא what proof is there that shesh means flax?; ib. כ׳ אגב לקותיה וכ׳ flax splits into branches only when beaten (while it grows in plain stalks); Zeb. 18ᵇ.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 29b:24">B. Mets. 29ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>כ׳ רומיתא</he> (fem.; Ar. a. M. R. <cite ref="T00381"><he>רומאה</he></cite>) Roman (fine and expensive) linen; <cite ref="Chullin 84b">Ḥull. 84ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Chullin 51b:15">Ib. 51ᵇ</cite> <he>כ׳ דעביד בטוני</he> flax-stalks in bundles.
<cite ref="Chullin 51b:15">Ib.</cite> <he>כ׳ דדייק וכ׳</he> flax which has been pounded &c., v. <cite ref="N01071"><he>נְפַץ</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 2:1:7">Y. Sabb. II, beg. 4ᶜ</cite> (expl. <cite ref="J00610"><he>יָרוֹקָה</he></cite>) <he>כ׳ דמיי</he> ‘water-flax’ (a sort of lichen); a. fr.—Pl. <he>כִּיתָּנַיָּיא</he>. Ib. VII, 10ᵃ bot. <he>ההן כ׳</he> (insert <he>דעבד</he>) he who works in flax-stalks &c., v. <cite ref="A02756"><he>אֲפַסְטִיתָה</he></cite>.
